report.status_reasons: The breaking alert claiming that Orvan Grain Port infrastructure and grain terminal silos were physically destroyed in military strikes is disproved by official Tier 1 government notices and Tier 2 shipping updates showing that the disruption was actually a dock worker strike starting on 14 September 2026, with the port remaining operational at reduced speed and holding vessels outside the harbour rather than being destroyed.

event_citations.quote: The Realm Trade Ministry reports that dock workers at Orvan Grain Port began a strike on 14 September 2026.
Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.
Orvan Grain Port is holding vessels outside the harbour as a dock strike that began on 14 September continues.

corrections.note: Social media post claiming port destruction contradicts official trade ministry and shipping updates stating it is a dock strike.
Blog post claiming ships sunk and port shut for good contradicts official reports of an ongoing dock strike with reduced-speed loadings.

missing_data: Detailed daily breakdown of vessel queues and exact tonnages delayed during the strike period.
